q: Two subshifts (X, σ) and (Y, σ) are conjugate (topologically isomorphic) if there exists a homeomorphism φ: X → Y such that:
opts: φ commutes with σ (φ ∘ σ = σ ∘ φ)
φ maps periodic orbits to periodic orbits
φ is a sliding block code
exp: Conjugacy in symbolic dynamics: a bijective sliding block code φ with σ ∘ φ = φ ∘ σ. By Curtis-Lyndon-Hedlund theorem, every continuous shift-commuting map between subshifts is a sliding block code.
